puck.tip: Click for the ring. Drag to move.
puck.hidden: Hidden from screen shares and recordings

ring.dictateOff: Dictation is off. Turn it on in Settings
ring.invisibleUnsupported: Linux cannot hide a window from captures
ring.caption: To {{name}}

compose.title: Message
compose.emptyTray: Screenshots, PDFs, videos and folders you add go out with this message. You can also drop files here.
compose.notePlaceholder: Add a note, or record one and read it back here

rec.transcribeFailed: The recording is saved but could not be transcribed: {{error}}
rec.nothingHeard: Nothing was heard in that recording.
rec.micBusy: A meeting is using the microphone.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.intro: Records both sides of a call: your microphone is written as You and the call's audio as Them. Each meeting gets its own folder you can search, correct and send.
meeting.recordingHelp: You can fold this away; the Stapler keeps recording and shows the time.
meeting.transcribingHelp: You can fold this away. The transcript is saved to the meeting's folder when it is done.
meeting.failed: The meeting could not be finished: {{error}}
meeting.privacy: Speech is transcribed on this machine unless you chose Groq. Recordings are deleted 24 hours after they are transcribed.

to.title: Send to
to.help: Everything the Stapler catches goes to the agent you pick here. It remembers your choice.
to.noRoster: Open the office window to see your agents. Until then everything goes to the orchestrator.
to.onlyOrchestrator: Only the orchestrator is on the floor right now.
to.gone: The agent you picked has left the floor, so this goes to the orchestrator.

settings.title: Stapler settings
settings.stopFirst: Stop the recording before turning the Stapler off.
settings.invisible: Invisible to screen shares and recordings
settings.invisibleHelp: It also hides on its own while it records a message or a meeting.
settings.invisibleUnsupported: Linux has no way to keep a window out of screen captures, so the Stapler stays visible there.
settings.resetHelp: Puts the puck in the middle of its screen.
settings.shortcutWhat: starts and stops a meeting from any app
settings.shortcutOff: Works while the Stapler is on.

shortcutError.taken: Another app already uses this shortcut, so it is not active. Close that app's shortcut and try again, or use the ring.
shortcutError.wayland: Under Wayland the desktop may not pass global shortcuts to apps. If it does nothing, use the ring.
shortcutError.failed: The shortcut could not be registered.

settings.screenshotsHelp: Screenshot freezes the screen under the pointer. Drag a region; Enter or a double-click reuses the last one; Esc cancels.
settings.screenshotsWayland: Under Wayland your desktop asks which screen to share each time you take a screenshot.
settings.meetingsFolderHelp: One folder per meeting, with meeting.json and a readable transcript.md.

permission.body: macOS needs the Screen Recording permission before the Stapler can take screenshots. Turn on Munder Difflin in System Settings, Privacy & Security, Screen Recording.
permission.relaunch: Quit and reopen the app after you turn it on.

overlay.hint: Drag over what you want · Esc cancels · shot {{count}} of {{max}}
overlay.hintRemembered: Drag a new region, or press Enter for the last one · Esc cancels · shot {{count}} of {{max}}

library.subtitle: Meetings, screenshots and messages from any app
library.loadFailed: The meetings folder could not be read.
library.emptyBody: Record a meeting from the Stapler's ring, or with the shortcut. Each one lands here with You and Them, ready to correct and send.
library.noResultsBody: Nothing mentions "{{query}}" in a title, description or transcript.
library.goneBody: Its folder was deleted or moved.
library.recordingNow: This meeting is recording now. Stop it from the Stapler to correct and send it.
library.failedBody: The transcript could not be made: {{error}}
library.interruptedBody: The app stopped while this meeting was being recorded or transcribed.
library.noAudio: There is no recording left to transcribe.
library.retention: Recordings are kept for 7 days until they are transcribed, and 24 hours after.
library.descriptionPlaceholder: What was this meeting about? Decisions, follow-ups.
library.emptyTranscript: Nothing was said in this meeting.

errors.limit: Eight shots is the most one message can carry. Send these first, or remove one.
errors.screenFailed: The screen could not be captured. {{detail}}
errors.captureFailed: The recording could not be saved.
errors.notImplemented: Transcription is not set up in this build yet.
errors.timeout: It took too long, so the Stapler stopped waiting.
errors.unknownAgent: That agent is no longer on the floor.
errors.empty: There is nothing to send yet.
errors.forbidden: Only the Stapler window can do that.
errors.busy: The Stapler is busy with that already.
errors.noDisplay: No screen was found to put the Stapler on.
errors.noCapture: There is no recording to stop.
errors.meetingStart: The meeting folder could not be created.
